type ReleaseParams = {
  mass: {
    attempts: number
    profile: { id: string } | null
  }
  energy: {
    channel: BroadcastChannel
    socket: WebSocket
  }
}

export default async function release({ energy, mass }: ReleaseParams) {
  void energy.channel
  void energy.socket
  void mass.attempts
  void mass.profile
}
